key_interactions.action: Do not use tamsulosin 0.4 mg with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (erythromycin); CYP2D6 inhibitors (paroxetine, terbinafine)
key_interactions.action: Use with caution, especially above 0.4 mg.
